links.outcome: Change in LLM predictions of cost, hospitalization, and mortality when patient race varied
links.effect: Models projected higher costs and longer hospitalizations for white populations and gave much higher survival rates in challenging medical scenarios.
links.quote: We find that these models tend to project higher costs and longer hospitalizations for white populations and exhibit optimistic views in challenging medical scenarios with much higher survival rates.

screen.reason: Empirical benchmark evaluating racial bias and disparities in medical report generation and clinical predictions by large language models.
